spans.s: गुह् vt. 1U (pp. गूढ; pres. गूहति-ते) To cover, to hide, to conceal, to keep secret, गूहेत्कूर्म इवांगानि M.vii.105, R.xiv.49, Bt.xvi.41.With उप-, to embrace, तरंगहस्तैरुपगूहतीव R.xiii.63, xviii.47, Bt.xiv.52.With नि-, to hide, to conceal.
गुह m. 1. An epithet of Kārtikeya, गुह इवाप्रतिहतशक्तिः Kad., K.S.v.14; 2. a horse; 3. name of a caṇḍāla king of Śṛngavera, a friend of Rāma.
गुहा f. 1. A cave, a cavern, a hiding place, गुहानिबद्धप्रतिशब्ददीर्घम् R.ii.28, 51; 2. a pit, a hole in the ground; 3. the heart; 4. hiding, concealing.
गुहा-आहित a. placed in the heart.
गुहा-शय m. 1. a mouse; 2. the supreme soul.
गुहिन n. A wood, a thicket.
गुहेर m. 1. A guardian, a protector; 2. a blacksmith.
गुह्य (I) a. (f. ह्या) 1. To be concealed; 2. secret, solitary, retired; 3. mysterious, Bg.xviii.63.

गुह्य (II) m. 1. Hypocrisy^1; 2. a tortoise.
[1] Correction submitted by Scott Rhodes on 20260516. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/224.
गुह्य (III) n. 1. A secret, a mystery, मौनं चैवास्मि गुह्यानाम् Bg.x.38; 2. a privity, the male or female organ of generation.
गुह्य (I) a. (f. ह्या) 1. To be concealed; 2. secret, solitary, retired; 3. mysterious, Bg.xviii.63.
गुह्य-गुरु m. an epithet of Śiva.
गुह्य-मय m. an epithet of Kārtikeya.
गुह्यक m. Name of a class of demigods who like the Yakshas are attendants of Kubera and guardians of his treasures, गुह्यकस्तं ययाचे Megh.i.5.
